I’m a Senior at Claremont McKenna College studying Data Science and Psychology, and I play on the varsity men’s tennis team. I’m the founder and CEO of SEVA, a performance tennis apparel brand, and I’m currently a Strategy and Operations Intern at Indie Ridge, a direct-to-consumer motorcycle apparel brand. Having grown up between Hong Kong and the US, I’m drawn to fast-moving consumer brands and to using data to understand how people make decisions.
